verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents a public HTTP API (`POST /v2/query`) that works the same against a local server and a Helix Cloud gateway, with Bearer-token auth and scoped API keys. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at docs.helix-db.com/openapi.json. Typed SDKs in Rust, TypeScript, Go and Python wrap the same operation-tree contract, and the TypeScript SDK exposes structured, retry-aware errors. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.
